title: Template demonstration
instruction: Shows every template block the shell renders, so a maker can see the frame before the chapter lands.
intro: This chapter is the shell's own sample. guide_build.py places it only with --demo, and only where a chapter file is missing.

rules.title: A rule is one plain sentence.
rules.rule: State the rule in one to three sentences. The shell sets it large, under the h3 that starts with its Rule ID.

why.text: Readers scan for the rule first and read the reason second, so the rule leads.

correct.caption: A short notice set at true size: body text in Charcoal on Newsprint.

failure.caption: Fails Rule 01.1. The same notice with its body in secondary gray at 12 px, under the 13 px floor.

rules.builders: Read the surface first, then the role: text primary on Newsprint is --oa-color-text-primary-on-newsprint.

code.name: Save button
code.caption: Template demonstration: the code to copy, live in both themes. Copy each file into a page that links tokens.css.

rules.title: A corrective example appears only when it teaches.
rules.rule: Add a corrective specimen when the repair is not obvious from the failure.

why.text: WCAG asks 3 to 1 for the edges that identify a control.

correct.caption: A field with a Charcoal edge.

failure.caption: Fails Rule 01.2. The edge is too faint to find, under the 3 to 1 of WCAG 1.4.11.

corrective.caption: The repair: the edge moves to the strong border token.

extras.caption: An extra sits between rules: a table, a sheet or a demo.

sources: W3C, Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2, Recommendation, December 12, 2024.
